description: Every game system the mashup touches. Each row generates one entry of g_systems[] in generated/ts_data.h.

rows.name: Game probe
rows.whatItDoes: Finds and validates the RA2/YR host folder and the Counter-Strike: Source companion folder, and reports what each contains
rows.notes: Reads RA2_DIR and CSS_DIR from the environment, set by Melty file mappings

rows.name: INI merge
rows.whatItDoes: Extracts the host game's own rulesmd.ini, artmd.ini and soundmd.ini from its archives and appends the mashup's generated sections
rows.notes: The originals are never shipped; they are read from the player's copy and rewritten in place each run

rows.name: Weapon statistics
rows.whatItDoes: Reads Counter-Strike: Source's own weapon scripts and converts Damage, ClipSize, CycleTime, Range and Recoil into RA2/YR WeaponType numbers
rows.notes: scripts/weapon_*.txt inside the companion's VPK archives

rows.name: Weapon sounds
rows.whatItDoes: Extracts Counter-Strike: Source's real firing, reload and C4 sounds and repacks them into an RA2/YR audio.bag / audio.idx pair
rows.notes: Optional stage: if it cannot be done the mashup still runs on the host game's own sounds

rows.name: Sidebar cameo icons
rows.whatItDoes: Decodes Counter-Strike: Source weapon textures and renders 60x48 SHP cameos quantised to the host game's own cameo palette
rows.notes: Optional stage; falls back to a cameo already in the host game

rows.name: Operator infantry
rows.whatItDoes: Adds four Counter-Strike operator infantry to the host game, armed with the converted weapons
rows.notes: Bodies reference the host game's own infantry art by name, so nothing is copied out of it

rows.name: C4 plant and defuse
rows.whatItDoes: A bomb carrier infantry plants a C4 charge that detonates with Counter-Strike: Source's own bomb sounds and a warhead scaled to its blast

rows.name: Combat economy
rows.whatItDoes: Tunes the host game's crate economy so fighting pays, the closest thing to Counter-Strike's round economy the vanilla rules allow
rows.notes: Per-kill bounties need a code extender; see DESIGN.md, open question OQ-1

rows.name: EVA briefing
rows.whatItDoes: Adds a short EVA brief line for the terror strike objective using the host game's own EVA voices

rows.name: Install manifest and uninstall
rows.whatItDoes: Records every file written into the host folder so it can be removed or refreshed cleanly

rows.name: Launch host
rows.whatItDoes: Starts the host game's own executable and waits for it to exit
rows.notes: gamemd.exe for Yuri's Revenge, game.exe for Red Alert 2
